title: 3.03 / Typography / Gotham
slide_intent: Choose a consistent headline voice so readers recognize emphasis before reading the details.
strategic_value: Gotham can give Spectrum headlines a recurring modern, approachable character.
demonstration: A large Gotham name and character specimen lead five roman/italic weight pairs, with a special restriction on Black.
practical_value: Select a headline weight and preserve the distinction between normal hierarchy and occasional accents.

content_islands.name: Heading and usage notes
content_islands.spec: Set title left, headline role in the middle and font access and Arial fallback notes at upper right.

content_islands.name: Gotham specimen
content_islands.spec: Place a cyan family name above large uppercase, lowercase, numerals and punctuation.

content_islands.name: Weight comparison
content_islands.spec: Align roman and italic weights in parallel columns below, with the Black restriction beside them.

ingredient.name: Gotham
ingredient.role: Give primary and secondary headlines a consistent voice.
ingredient.application: Use Gotham for primary and secondary headlines. Reserve Black for sparse accents, never headlines or body text.
ingredient.scope: 2017 retail guide. Arial Regular and Bold are internal-document fallbacks when Gotham and Whitney are unavailable.
